chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who missed one rak'ah with the Imam during the days of Tashreeq. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He completes the prayer and says Takbir.'

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيق: Days of Tashreeq (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who misses one rak'ah of Eid prayer with the Imam?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the procedural ruling for a worshipper who joins the Eid prayer late, specifically during the days of Tashreeq, instructing them to complete the missed portion as two rak'ahs with the accompanying Takbir. In Shia jurisprudence, this highlights the flexibility in compensating for missed units of congregational prayer while maintaining the integrity of the Eid ritual. The emphasis on completing the prayer underscores the importance of fulfilling the obligatory act even when joining late, reflecting the practical application of fiqh in communal worship settings.
